name: 布偶拼布定格
line: 花布、纽扣和针脚缝出来的布偶和田园，暖阳下走一段路，柔软又有乡土味
line_en: Rag dolls and countryside sewn from floral cloth, buttons and stitches; a walk in warm sun, soft and homely

best.subject: Countryside, farms, country lanes, going to market, moving house: a story of walking a stretch of road across a big patchwork map; a group of small animals setting off in a line, finding a lost companion
best.palette: Soft countryside colours: wheat yellow, apple green, sky blue, floral pink, off-white; floral and gingham patterns
best.light: Warm afternoon sun low from behind to the side, weave and seams casting tiny shadows; warm overall, soft contrast
best.camera: Medium, medium-close and wide shots at eye level close to the ground, to see button eyes and stitches; extreme-wide shots (showing the route) look down at an angle from above, like viewing a patchwork map from a hillside

good_for: Stories of setting out, travelling, looking for something
A band of companions moving in a line
bad_for: Night scenes, dark tones, tense thrilling subjects
Fast fights, comedy with big deformation
Stories set entirely in one small room (wastes the fields)

music.desc: Country folk: recorder sings the melody, harmonica answers behind it, strumstick on the offbeats, pizzicato double bass, cajón and tambourine one beat per step like walking; key actions hit with a strumstick gliss and cajón, cowbell to close

voice.tone: Bright and unhurried, like talking while walking along a field path, with a little smile

transitions.name: Push into a field
transitions.how: Not part of the transition family, no tr=: in the extreme-wide map the camera slowly pushes toward the patch of fabric where the hero is (to about 1.16), and on the most pushed-in drawing hard cuts to an eye-level shot on that same patch (a separately generated background whose ground is written as the same fabric). The camera changes from an angled top-down view to eye level with the same fabric, so it is not a jump cut. One whoosh. Use only on the two extreme-wide map shots (after recognising the road, in cross-cutting), not in the opening: the opening is an eye-level wide shot

transitions.name: Floral cloth cover
transitions.how: A piece of floral fabric flicks in from the left of the frame and covers the lens, then lifts off to the right to reveal the next scene. Asset: generate a big piece of floral fabric filling the frame with the texture type (prompt in STYLE.md "Compositing"), save as src/fx_smear_tex.png; the template's load() reads it automatically. In SHOTS write tr='cloth_flap'. whoosh plus thud. Once per film, at a section boundary (e.g. the cut point of cross-cutting between two lines)

transitions.name: Stitch wipe
transitions.how: A stitched fabric edge sweeps vertically from left to right, the new picture behind it, a soft shadow on its right. Asset prop_seam (prop type: "a long stitched fabric-edge strip: a narrow off-white linen edge with one line of thick dark brown stitches down the middle, laid horizontally, perfectly straight"), save as src/prop_seam.png; the template's load() reads it automatically. In SHOTS write tr='stitch_wipe'. whoosh. Use for "remembering a road", "setting off from somewhere else"
